recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Any future edits to annotationType should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions while preserving the canonical URL, Annotation context, CodeableConcept value, and example v2-0364 binding.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 MnM request to create a standard Annotation extension for v2 NTE-4 note/comment type, with a CodeableConcept value and example binding to the v2-0364 comment type value set.
initial_application: Core history contains commit 51608b35e99a0fc80a1cc3abd49dbb5e19f8bb90 adding an annotation extension spreadsheet for FHIR-31541, but current core does not contain a complete active annotationType StructureDefinition there. Jira comments and HL7/fhir-extensions history show the lost extension was recovered through PR #48 in the Extension Pack.
additional_context: The current Extension Pack source defines http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/annotationType with Annotation context, CodeableConcept value, and example binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2-0364. The Extension Pack IG includes input/definitions/* and the published pages are available at build.fhir.org and hl7.org. Core source/fhir.ini has active profile entries for other datatype extension spreadsheets but no annotation-extensions entry.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch and made no source changes, because the source of truth for this extension is HL7/fhir-extensions rather than the current FHIR core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Earlier no-change Annotation.type request explains why a general base Annotation element was not added; FHIR-31541 approved a narrower standard extension.
Mentioned in the same 2023 OO minutes as another lost/found v2-to-FHIR extension but concerns a different artifact.
